# Karl Mayr GmbH & Co. KG

> Roofing, metalwork, glazing, facade construction, sealing, and green roof specialists in Saalfelden am Steinernen Meer, Austria. Family-run master craftsman business since 1972.

## Company Overview

Karl Mayr GmbH & Co. KG is a leading roofing and construction company based in Saalfelden, Salzburg, Austria. Founded in 1972, the company has over 50 years of experience and employs 49 skilled professionals, including 3 master craftsmen. They complete over 100 projects annually across the Pinzgau region and greater Salzburg area.

## Services

- **Dachdeckerei (Roofing)**: Complete roof construction, renovation, repair, and maintenance. All roof types including pitched roofs, flat roofs, and specialty roofing.
- **Spenglerei (Metalwork/Tinsmithing)**: Custom sheet metal work, gutters, downspouts, flashings, metal cladding, and copper work.
- **Glaserei (Glazing)**: Glass installation, window glazing, glass facades, shower enclosures, mirrors, and specialty glass work.
- **Fassade (Facade Construction)**: Building facades, exterior cladding, insulation systems (ETICS/WDVS), and facade renovation.
- **Abdichtungsarbeiten (Sealing/Waterproofing)**: Building waterproofing, basement sealing, flat roof sealing, and moisture protection.
- **Gründächer (Green Roofs)**: Extensive and intensive green roof systems, rooftop gardens, and ecological roofing solutions.

Saalfelden am Steinernen Meer, Pinzgau, Zell am See district, and the greater Salzburg region in Austria.

- Founded: 1972
- Employees: 49

- Vehicles/fleet: 36

- Trade certifications: Dachdecker (Roofer), Spengler (Tinsmith), Glaser (Glazier)
- Trade association: Innung der Dachdecker und Spengler

- Over 50 years of experience in roofing and building envelope construction

- Local company with deep knowledge of Alpine building requirements and weather conditions
- Modern fleet of 36 vehicles for efficient project execution
- Trusted by residential, commercial, and public sector clients across the Salzburg region
